let Column := Nat → Bool
let disj (ws : List Column) (r : Nat) := ws.any (fun w => w r)
let both (a b : Column) (r : Nat) := a r && b r
let wire (s : List Column) (i : Nat) := s.getD i (fun _ => false)
let addOr (s : List Column) (g : Nat × Nat) := s ++ [fun r => wire s g.1 r || wire s g.2 r]
let good (p a b : Nat) (w : Column) := w p = true → w a = true ∨ w b = true
let separated (s : List Column) := ∃ n : Fin 257 → Fin 468, ∀ i j : Fin 257, i.val < j.val →
    ∃ p : Fin 52, ∀ w ∈ s, good p.val (52 + (n i).val) (52 + (n j).val) w
let Gate := Bool × Nat × Nat
let step (s : List Column) (g : Gate) : List Column :=
  if g.1 then s ++ [both (wire s g.2.1) (wire s g.2.2)] else addOr s g.2

let extend (x : Nat) : Nat :=
  let b (i : Nat) := (x >>> i) &&& 1
  x ||| ((b 0 &&& b 13) <<< 26) ||| ((b 0 ||| b 14) <<< 27) |||
    ((b 1 &&& b 13) <<< 28) ||| ((b 1 &&& b 18) <<< 29)
let pos (i : Nat) := extend (positive[i]!)
let neg (i : Nat) := extend (negative[i]!)
let input (j : Nat) : Column := fun r =>
  (if r < 52 then pos r else neg (r-52)).testBit j
let base : List Column := List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 30 => input j.val) ++ [fun _ => false, fun _ => true]

let mate (i : Fin 468) : Fin 468 := ⟨partners[i.val]! % 468,Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩

(∀ i : Fin 468, mate (mate i) = i) ∧
    ((List.range 468).filter (fun i => decide (partners[i]! % 468 < i))).length = 54 ∧
    ∀ a b : Fin 468, a < b → (mate b ≠ a ↔
      ∃ p : Fin 52, pos p.val &&& (neg a.val ||| neg b.val) = pos p.val)
